title: Cracks in reality
post:
The feeling that you're in a dream. That the world you inhabit is different than the world you were born.

Our world isn't ending. It's already gone. The facade is fading, and the cracks in the walls are widening. Can't you just feel yourself slipping through.
author: prescient_realities
comments: The lengths people will go to deny reality just bc the world kinda sucks now. Grow up
